sections.title: AI security & GRC
sections.subtitle: Test the risks. Strengthen the controls. Build awareness.

sections.heading: Security and governance that work together
sections.body:
AI introduces new questions about access, behaviour and accountability. Linkfields brings offensive testing of AI, LLMs and web applications together with cloud security and governance, risk and compliance (GRC).

We help you connect technical findings with the controls, owners and evidence needed to address them. Security awareness keeps staff part of that response, through education and phishing drills.

sections.heading: Protect AI, people and the enterprise
sections.description: Offensive testing: AI, LLM & web app testing. Cloud security & GRC: Controls, IAM & regulation.

cards.title: Offensive testing

cards.title: AI guardrails

cards.title: Staff awareness
cards.description: Security awareness: Staff education & phishing drills. Help people recognise suspicious activity and understand how to report it.

sections.heading: A clear path from findings to action
sections.description: Define a scope that reflects the systems you run, the information they use and the people responsible for them.

items.title: Agree the scope
items.description: Map AI services, applications and cloud dependencies. Agree the testing boundaries, control requirements and stakeholders involved.

items.title: Test and assess
items.description: Carry out agreed offensive testing and control reviews. Record findings in a form that delivery teams and risk owners can use.

items.title: Prioritise remediation
items.description: Connect technical issues with business risk. Agree actions, responsible owners and a way to check that changes address the findings.

items.title: Build ongoing readiness
items.description: Review evidence, rehearse reporting and reinforce staff awareness. Revisit the assessment as systems and requirements change.
